description: This file defines a TorchScript compatible implementation of the Adam optimizer in a functional style for distributed training in PyTorch. It includes a class `_FunctionalAdam` with methods to initialize optimizer parameters and update model parameters using gradient information, intended for internal distributed optimizer internals.
